Plot a hat-value diagnostic

Source: R/plot-hat-values.R
autoplot.hat_values_result.Rd

Draws one of two views of a check_hat_values() result. type = "null" shows the null distribution of \(\hat{\phi}\) as a histogram with the observed \(\hat{\phi}\) and the conf_level null quantile marked. type = "profile" shows the proportion of high-leverage candidates at each exposure percentile, the leverage profile across the exposure range.

Arguments

object

A hat_values_result from check_hat_values().

type

One of "null" or "profile".

...

Not used.

Value

A ggplot2::ggplot object.

Examples

set.seed(1)
n <- 200
x1 <- rnorm(n)
dose <- rnorm(n, mean = x1)
df <- data.frame(dose = dose, x1 = x1)
# null_reps is small here to keep the example fast.
result <- check_hat_values(df, dose, x1, null_reps = 50)

autoplot(result, type = "null")

autoplot(result, type = "profile")
